name: Isolate him
engine: The decoy drags a centre-back, so the full-back beside him is on his own: your wingers run at him with two dice, and every man they beat stays rattled.
about: Every attack a centre-back of theirs follows Oyarzabal, the decoy, so the full-back beside him has no cover inside him and is on his own (against Argentina that is Tagliafico, up against Yamal). Yamal and Baena cut inside: against a man on his own a clean win needs only 3. Isolate him gives your wingers, carriers and finishers two dice on their runs at a man on his own, and +1 on a pass to them past him. A run that beats a man cleanly leaves him rattled until he wins a duel against you (Run at him), and the captain, Rodri, points him out: once an attack a half win against him counts as a clean win. Their defence is set for the last kind of move each of your men tried (Guessing), so a winger who ran last time is better off passing, and the other way round.
